An unrelated changing label immediately after the button can suppress recovery; the original assertions are neither weakened nor bypassed. New/unchanged/nonadjacent/ambiguous/interactive labels and different windows are excluded. AND-005.status: open: external fixture/input-method limitation; original flow still failing
AND-005.diagnosis: Injected TB and ADB deletes each remove one character but do not generate this React Native soft-key-only onKeyPress callback. Enter already introduces one counted callback; Gboard Delete taps increment it, reaching three. Omitting Enter with two soft-key taps gives two.
AND-005.inference: Enter-related IME composition/autocapitalization likely causes the extra callback; exact InputConnection internals were not instrumented.
AND-005.decision: Do not weaken the original assertion or change generic key injection to manufacture callbacks. Propose separate text-result and explicitly soft-key callback fixture tests.
